title: Explicit focus-event matcher (isolate semantic matching before memory writing)
frozen_recurrence: S_t = S_{t-1} + B_t(k_t ⊙ v_t), gamma=1, omega=0, one persistent bank, no C_t, no slots, no quadratic; SelectivePhaseV2 unmodified (gate via gate_override)

method.matcher: z_f=LN(W_f f_t), z_h=LN(W_h h_t); cosine s=cos/tau or bilinear s=z_f^T M z_h; two-stage B_t=sigmoid(W_e h)*sigmoid(a*s+b); f_t=causal header-captured summary; no oracle bit/future/target at inference
method.losses: pairwise ranking (primary) + event-vs-filler BCE + write-budget + alignment
method.hard_negatives: frequency-matched repeated distractor entity; only focus-identity-match separates relevant from distractor
method.discipline: COND-MLP preserved as frozen baseline; matchers added as new arms; 2-seed pilot selects candidate; 3-seed hard-negative confirmation + causal controls decides promotion

causal_controls_bilinear_hard.interpretation: advantage collapses to chance without correct focus summary -> genuine focus-event matching, NOT a shortcut

promotion.reason_not_promoted: discrimination solved causally, but no downstream decode/write-economy gain over COND-MLP because the memory task is saturated (COND-MLP decodes 1.000 writing ~only the cue)
promotion.cosine_fallback_reason: not required: bilinear_hard PASSED the causal controls (fallback is only for a shortcut/failed-controls candidate)

final_selection_priority: causal focus dependence (PASS, delta +0.298) -> hard-neg discrimination (PASS 0.80) -> rel-vs-hard margin (PASS) -> write separation (PASS 0.77>0.39) -> decode non-regression (marginal FAIL 0.988<1.000) -> simplicity (cosine ~ bilinear causally)
verdict: Explicit focus-event matching VALIDATED as causal discrimination (AUROC 0.62->0.80, causal_delta +0.30); NOT promoted downstream (task saturated; write-coupling unresolved).
next_permitted_step: gate calibration / write-coupling on a NON-saturated memory task (show validated relevance improves downstream recall where writes matter). Do NOT proceed to slots/consolidation/quadratic on discrimination alone; do NOT run further similarity sweeps. If a non-saturated task still shows no downstream gain, move to contrastive focus-event representation learning.
